client: Clipboardly

text: Mina did a great job on our support ticket analytics project. She built a useful dashboard in Power BI from our Zendesk data and cleaned up the tagging structure so we could see response times and backlog by product area. The dashboard helped us spot staffing changes, and our first response time dropped 27% after we acted on it. Solid work, easy to work with, and exactly what we needed.
